methodology.fixture: examples/primitives/cube.obj plus Body primitive; 120 moves per gesture
methodology.sequence: Serial baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline for each unrecorded condition
methodology.sources: 0.1.4 at 3fa664d; 0.1.5 production at a4501be; same native binaries
methodology.recordings: One baseline and candidate recording per condition; order alternates
methodology.display: 1500x950 nonactivating window, DPR 1.5, Windows 11; no parallel test/build
methodology.handler: Synchronous input handling; excludes OS queue wait and physical input latency
methodology.frames: GUI receipt of frameSwapped; not physical display or GPU execution time
methodology.retention: 128 MiB owned budget; complete means clean stop, not zero ring eviction
methodology.limits: Two unrecorded repeats; normal then Ctrl; background/thermal state uncontrolled
methodology.overlap: Profiler inclusive spans overlap; do not sum or subtract collector costs
